metadata.case_name: PETER JOEAN WONG AND ANOTHER v. MAK YIU SUM AND ANOTHER

injuries.description: bruises at the 8th and 9th rib area
source: The 1st Plaintiff was fortunate enough not to have sustained any injury apart from bruises at the 8th and 9th rib area.
The 2nd Plaintiff sustained, as a result of the accident, a fracture of the right clavicle and the 4th rib on her left chest.
to his surprise, the 2nd Plaintiff's fracture to the clavicle had still not united in December 1984 when he examined her.

injuries.description: fracture of the 4th rib on her left chest
source: The 2nd Plaintiff sustained, as a result of the accident, a fracture of the right clavicle and the 4th rib on her left chest.

injuries.description: secondary frozen shoulder of the right shoulder with 10% permanent disability due to restricted movement
source: According to Dr. David Lee, she now suffers from a 10% permanent disability of her right shoulder due to restricted movement consequential upon the development of a secondary frozen shoulder.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injuries to the shoulder or upper arm

manifestations.description: pain and suffering for a minor injury (bruises at the 8th and 9th rib area)
restricted movement of the right shoulder
severe pain to her right shoulder
not able to do any house work
not able to lift any weight
could no longer take the morning strolls up the hill as often as she did prior to the accident

treatments_received: bonesetter treatment between 5th March 1984 and 3rd April 1984
physiotherapy (15 sessions) with Dr. Y.Y. Kwok between 12th April 1984 and 5th May 1984
consultations with Dr. Kwok, Dr. Wong, Dr. Leung, Dr. Ho
examination by Dr. David Lee on 20th December 1984
treatments_future: intensive daily physiotherapy for a period of 6 to 8 weeks (prescribed by Dr. David Lee)
force manipulation of the shoulder under anaesthesia if physiotherapy fails (suggested by Dr. David Lee)
3 months' sick leave recommended by Dr. Fung of the United Christian Hospital

losses.category: Loss of ability to do domestic tasks
losses.description: 2nd Plaintiff was not able to do any house work

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: 2nd Plaintiff could no longer take the morning strolls up the hill as often as she did prior to the accident
restricted movement of the right shoulder

losses.category: Loss of ability to enjoy quiet or solitude
losses.description: 2nd Plaintiff was not able to sleep
